name: Cheesy Tortilla Breakfast Pizza
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Whisk the eggs together and season with salt and pepper.
Put the wrap in an oven-safe frying pan with the edges just turned up, pour the egg over it, and scatter over the chopped tomatoes, thinly sliced onion and grated cheddar.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes until the egg has set and the cheese is golden, then serve.
